lifecycle.label: Deprecation response signals
lifecycle.hint: Select a header to see what it tells your client.

items.title: A version is deprecated
items.description: Every response from a deprecated version carries this header. It announces the deprecation using RFC 9745.

items.title: A removal date is fixed
items.description: Responses also carry this header once a removal date is fixed. RFC 8594 defines the date when the version stops answering.

items.title: The replacement is identified
items.description: Alongside the removal date, a Link with rel="successor-version" points your client to the replacement version.
